value.rationale: The result provides the complete hierarchy and exact multiplicities for every subcode dimension in an infinite newly published family. It isolates a sharp structural phenomenon: all levels through codimension two remain the simplex values, while only the two top levels detect the appended blocks. Higher-support data are standard invariants for wiretap, erasure, and trellis questions, so this is more than a routine re-expression of the ordinary weight enumerator.
